description: Point the cmssy editor at the deployed app: stores the origin of `url` as the workspace preview URL, the address the editor frames. Use the exact deployed origin (https://my-site.vercel.app) - a wrong host, such as an added www., leaves the editor reporting that the preview did not respond.

url.description: The deployed app's URL, e.g. https://my-site.vercel.app. Only its origin is stored.

name: set_preview_url
title: Set preview url
